verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a reporting area that gives 'a visual representation of your balances, sales, and payouts', plus configurable payout frequency and a Customer Area transaction overview. That is only glancing support for settlement-to-bank reconciliation. No evidence shows itemized settlement reports or a breakdown of fees, refunds, and chargebacks matched to bank deposits. Missing for 10: settlement or payout reconciliation reports tying batches to bank deposits, itemized fee/refund/chargeback line items, report export or API access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
